_readme: Optional one-off art. By default every course uses its region's hero/engraving/vignette and the standard collectible frames with its name drawn in. List a course here to give it a destination hero and/or fully custom collectible images; `npm run art:prompts` then creates prompts for exactly these files. The app also picks up any of these files automatically if present.

_example._note: Template only. Copy into a real course id.
